rows.question: Nawa ne buhun shinkafa?
rows.reply: Ina neman afuwar, ban da wannan bayanin ba. Don Allah ku tuntubi mai shi a WhatsApp akan +2348012345678 tsakanin karfe 8 na safe zuwa 6 na yamma don tambaya.
rows.english: I am sorry, I do not have that information. Please contact the owner on WhatsApp at +2348012345678 between 8am and 6pm to ask.

rows.question: Nawa ne buhun wake?
rows.reply: Ba ni da matakan hannun jari na yanzu don wake. Don Allah ku tuntubi mai shi ta WhatsApp a +2348012345678 tsakanin karfe 8 na safe zuwa 6 na yamma domin duba samuwarsa.
rows.english: I don't have the current stock levels for beans. Please contact the owner on WhatsApp at +2348012345678 between 8am and 6pm to check availability.

rows.question: Yaushe kuke buɗe shago?
rows.reply: Muna buɗewa da karfe 8 na safe kuma muna rufewa da karfe 6 na yamma daga Litinin zuwa Asabar.
rows.english: We open at 8am and close at 6pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Ina shagonku yake?
rows.reply: Muna nan a Shago 12, kasuwar Dawanau.
rows.english: We are located at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: Nawa ne buhun masara?
rows.reply: Ina neman afuwar ku, amma ba ni da farashi ga masara. Zan bukaci in duba tare da mai gidan don ku. Kuna so ku yi odar wani abu, ko kuma in haɗa ku da mutum?
rows.english: I am sorry, but I do not have a price for maize. I will need to check with the owner for you. Would you like to place an order for another item, or should I connect you with a person?

rows.question: Elo ni àpò ìrẹsì?
rows.english: A 50 kg bag of rice costs ₦82,000.

rows.question: Elo ni àpò ẹ̀wà?
rows.reply: Ma binu, ṣugbọn emi ko ta awon ohun mimu. Mo n ta iresi, ewa, ati oka nikan. O le ṣayẹwo awọn idiyele fun awọn nkan wọnyẹn ti o ba fẹ.
rows.english: I am sorry, but I do not sell sweets. I only sell rice, beans, and maize. You can check the prices for those items if you like.

rows.question: Ìgbà wo ni ẹ máa ń ṣí ṣọ́ọ̀bù?
rows.reply: We are open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.
rows.english: We are open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Níbo ni ṣọ́ọ̀bù yín wà?
rows.reply: A wa ni ile itaja 12, ọjà Dawanau.
rows.english: We are located at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: Elo ni àpò àgbàdo?
rows.reply: Mi ò ní iye owó tó dájú fún àpò oka rí. Mo nilo lati ṣayẹwo pẹlu eni naa fun yin. O tun le de wọn lori WhatsApp ni +2348012345678 laarin 8 owurọ ati 6 irọlẹ.
rows.english: I don't have a price set for a bag of maize yet. I will need to check with the owner for you. You can also reach them on WhatsApp at +2348012345678 between 8am and 6pm.

rows.question: Ego ole ka akpa osikapa bụ?
rows.english: A 50 kg bag of rice is ₦82,000.

rows.question: Ego ole ka akpa agwa bụ?
rows.reply: Anaghị m ere poteto. Anọ m na-ere osikapa, agwa, na akpu. Ị ga-achọ ọnụ ahịa maka otu n'ime ha?
rows.english: I do not sell potatoes. I sell rice, beans, and maize. Would you like the price for one of those?

rows.question: Kedu oge unu na-emeghe ụlọ ahịa?
rows.reply: Anyị na-emeghe site n'ele 8 nke ụtụtụ ruo elekere 6 nke mgbede, Mọnde ruo Satọde.
rows.english: We are open from 8am to 6pm, Monday to Saturday.

rows.question: Ebee ka ụlọ ahịa unu dị?
rows.reply: Anyị dị na ụlọ ahịa 12, ahịa Dawanau.
rows.english: We are located at Shop 12, Dawanau market.

rows.question: Ego ole ka akpa ọka bụ?
rows.reply: Anaghị m enwe ọnụ ahịa maka ntụ ọka ma. Ana m ere ihe ubi, mana etinyebeghị ọnụ ahịa ahụ. Enwere m ike lelee ya na onye nwe ya maka gị.
rows.english: I do not have a price for corn flour. I sell maize, but the price is not set yet. I can check with the owner for you.
